// diagnostic

E0992

A multi-arm `if` needs a comparison between the subject and `{`.

What

A multi-arm `if` needs a comparison between the subject and `{`.

Why

`if subject == { … }` (or `<`, `>`, `!=`, `<=`, `>=`) marks value dispatch explicitly; a plain `if condition { … }` body is statements.

Fix

Write `if subject == { value -> body }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0992: tests/ui/e0992_multi_arm_if_needs_comparison.stderr.

 Fix: Write `if subject == { value -> body }`
